elements.description:
The ways to reach a person or an account – email, phone, messaging and address – each masked until revealed, with
its role, when it was last used and whether it's verified, Copy and the page's own actions.

properties.name: channels
properties.description: The contact points, in order; they're grouped by kind

properties.name: states
properties.description: Verification states' names and tones, merged over the defaults (verified, unverified, bounced, dormant, flagged)

properties.name: kindLabels
properties.description: The groups' names, merged over the defaults (Email, Phone, Messaging, Address)

properties.name: actions
properties.description: Actions added to every row after Copy, e.g. [{ id: "message", label: "Message" }]

properties.name: masked
properties.description: Masks values until revealed; set false to show them in full

properties.name: revealed
properties.description: The ids whose values are shown. Changed by the user unless a tc-revealed-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: locale
properties.description: The language for dates, e.g. "en-GB"; by default the browser's

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-revealed-change
events.description: A value was shown or masked again ({ revealed, id, shown }: ContactRevealedChange); cancelable – prevented, it stays as it was

events.name: tc-copy
events.description: Copy was pressed ({ channel, text }: ContactCopy); cancelable – prevented, nothing is copied

events.name: tc-action
events.description: One of the page's actions was pressed ({ action, channel }: ContactActionEvent)

functions.name: defaultContactStates
functions.signature: defaultContactStates: Record<string, { label: string; tone: ContactTone }>
functions.description: The verification states' names and tones used when the page gives none

functions.name: defaultContactKindLabels
functions.description: The groups' names used when the page gives none

functions.name: maskContact
functions.description:
A value masked by kind: an email keeps its first letter and domain, a phone number its last two digits, an address
its last part (the town), a handle its first letter

props.name: revealed
props.description: The ids whose values are shown – controlled when given

props.name: defaultRevealed
props.description: The ids shown on mount when `revealed` isn't controlled

props.name: onRevealedChange
props.description: A value was shown or masked again; `revealed` is the new list

props.name: onCopy
props.description: Copy was pressed; return false to stop the copy

props.name: onAction
props.description: One of the page's actions was pressed

changelog: **People & profiles:** - `tc-entity-timeline`: events by month, each with a category and a graded source, filtered by category. - `tc-travel-itinerary`: legs with mode, document, confidence and flags, grouped into journeys. - `tc-place-list`: places with type, status, coordinates and dates. - `tc-account-list`: masked IBAN-style accounts with a status and the page's own stats. - `tc-money-flow`: transfers between entities as bands sized by amount, with flag chips. - Entities' and transfers' flows are lit with a readout, and there's a table view. - `tc-co-occurrence`: entities ranked by the events they share with a subject. - Strength in words and bars, with counts per source. - `tc-evidence-list`: exhibits, each opening onto its chain of custody, with hash agreement. - `tc-asset-list`: grouped assets with masked identifiers and a status. - `tc-contact-channels`: emails, phone numbers, messaging and addresses. - Masked until shown, with role, last use and verification.

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: Container size queries
features.why: Components adapt to the width they're given, not the window's.

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.
